name: triyan
description: The literary home of Triyan, and of ABYSS.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @triyan/server && npm run build -w @triyan/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c magenta,cyan,white "npm:dev -w @triyan/shared" "npm:dev -w @triyan/server" "npm:dev -w @triyan/client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @triyan/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @triyan/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run build:shared && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
